raw:
I remember a customer at a laundromat whose basket split. Wet towels scattered across the floor, and I felt bad for them. Wet towels are awkward to carry even when you’ve got something to put them in, and now their basket wasn’t any use.

I had a spare canvas bag, so I offered it to them. My attention went from the towels on the floor to how they were going to carry everything. That was something I could help with. It wasn’t a big thing, but I wanted to make it a little easier for them.
